description: Country-allocation pressure model. Lead indicators estimate relative foreign-investor appetite; observed flows confirm or contradict the estimate and never enter the lead score.
guardrails: Do not call the score an actual capital-flow forecast.
Do not use contemporaneous observed flow in the lead score.
Do not alter signals, forecasts, construction weights, or trade plans before a point-in-time walk-forward backtest passes.
Separate equity, bond, FDI, bank, and resident-outflow channels when data become available.
Treat news as an event label or feature surprise, not generic sentiment.
